---
title: Quick Start
---

### Creating an account

All VU employees can create an account in DataverseNL. If you would like to start with DataverseNL please go to [DataverseNL](https://dataverse.nl/loginpage.xhtml?redirectPage=dataverseuser.xhtml). 

![DataverseNL login](/public/tools/dataversenl/dataverse_login.png)

### Uploading data

All VU employees can upload and publish datasets in DataverseNL. 

It is important to select your University and faculty when uploading data to DataverseNL. 

![Select VU](/public/tools/dataversenl/dataversenl_select_vu.png)

![Select Faculty](/public/tools/dataversenl/dataversenl_select_faculty.png)

![Add Data](/public/tools/dataversenl/dataversenl_add_data.png)

### Sensitive data 

Use DataverseNL only for archiving and publishing non-sensitive data. 

Do not use DataverseNL for archiving and publishing datasets that contain personal data or other types of confidential data. Even though access to data files in DataverseNL can be restricted, datasets containing personal data or other types of confidential data must not be uploaded to DataverseNL. A suitable repository for archiving and publishing personal and sensitive data is [Yoda](/tools/yoda/index.qmd).

For more information please visit the [DataverseNL website](https://dans.knaw.nl/en/data-services/dataversenl/user-guide/).
